key_insight: LLMs lose diagnostic accuracy when they must gather clinical information interactively rather than receive a complete case upfront.
clinical_relevance: Evaluating how models obtain relevant information—not just interpret it—is important before considering their use in diagnostic workflows.
method: Introduced Hx2Dx ARENA using 1,000 NEJM clinical cases.
Simulated encounters spanning history taking, physical examination, and diagnostic workup.
Evaluated open- and closed-source LLMs across configurations and compared interactive with static performance.
evidence_signal: Every evaluated model performed worse interactively than with the full case provided upfront; more targeted questioning was associated with better diagnostic performance.
watch_item: Results come from simulated encounters and do not establish safety or effectiveness in real-world patient care.
paper_title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
